description:
In Episode 220 we discuss the Biblical principal of Desolate. Whenever it is mentioned throughout the Bible, it’s a dire warning for God’s people. From Israel’s house that was left desolate to the abomination of desolation standing in the Holy place, God’s people are warned to separate from that that makes desolate. But what exactly is it that makes desolate, and what can we do to make sure that we do not get destroyed with it?
